CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_school_expense()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.finance_audit(action, expense_id, details, actor)
  values ('EXPENSE_' || tg_op, new.id, jsonb_build_object('before', case when tg_op = 'INSERT' then null else to_jsonb(old) end, 'after', to_jsonb(new)), auth.uid());
  return new;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_audit_log(target_log_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.audit_logs log
    join public.profiles actor on actor.id = log.actor_id
    where log.id = target_log_id
      and public.can_read_school_campus(actor.campus)
  );
$function$
findings.name: can_read_audit_log

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_shop_campus(target_campus text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select public.can_manage_shop_campus(target_campus) or (public.has_active_role('accountant')
   and target_campus in ('junior','senior') and public.accountant_can_access_campus(target_campus)
   and exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=auth.uid() and campus=target_campus));
$function$
findings.name: can_read_shop_campus

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_main_school_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.has_active_role('admin')
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles profile
      where profile.id = auth.uid()
        and profile.campus = 'all'
    );
$function$
